title: WorkExcellence AI
subtitle: Multi-Tenant AI Agent & RAG Backend
description: A multi-tenant AI backend service supporting streaming conversational workflows, tool-calling AI agents, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
highlights: Designed and developed a multi-tenant AI backend service supporting streaming conversational workflows, tool-calling AI agents, and RAG.

Implemented an extensible AI agent tool-execution framework with specialized tools (Activity, Element, PageCompletion, Tooltip, KnowledgeBase), thread-safe execution context propagation, and tool-response sanitization.
Developed document ingestion pipelines with OCR text extraction, text chunking, embedding generation, and semantic indexing using ChromaDB.
Engineered tenant-aware database connection routing, per-account API key resolution, reactive-to-blocking execution bridging, and authenticated inter-service communication via OpenFeign.

title: DA - Drive Analyzer (ULINK Technology)
subtitle: Drive Health Analytics & Predictive Monitoring
description: Backend modules of a multi-tenant drive-health analytics platform processing telemetry across 2M+ monitored drives globally.
highlights: Contributed to backend modules of a multi-tenant drive-health analytics platform processing telemetry across 2M+ monitored drives globally.
Worked on binary telemetry parsing using Kaitai Struct and conversion of drive logs into Avro records for storage and downstream analytics in AWS S3.
Monitored and maintained end-to-end Apache Airflow workflows covering S3 ingestion, Athena/Glue cataloging, hourly data processing, AI predictions, notifications, and TimescaleDB persistence.

Implemented OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flows across authorization and resource servers, OTP-based account activation, passwordless support-account access, and maintenance across a multimodule Maven application.

title: Portfolio & Blog Platform
subtitle: This site: React + Spring Boot
description: The site you're on. React + TypeScript frontend with a Spring Boot backend: JWT auth, PostgreSQL full-text search, Redis caching, nested comments with moderation, and OpenAPI docs.
highlights: Stateless JWT auth with Spring Security's OAuth2 resource server and role-based access (admin / visitor).
PostgreSQL full-text search over a weighted, generated tsvector column; Flyway-managed schema.
Redis caching for hot posts, rate-limited comments and contact form with honeypot spam protection.
Testcontainers integration tests and Docker Compose for the full stack.
